brief.whyItMatters: Research results decide what the next model generation can do. Knowing the method tells you whether a claimed gain will hold for your workload.

keyConcepts.explanation: Training after the base model exists, using examples or feedback, to make it follow instructions, reason in steps or refuse unsafe requests.
A fixed task set used to compare models. Scores mean little once the tasks leak into training data, so check how contamination was handled.
